verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any Grok feature for creating a custom assistant with its own instructions and knowledge base, or for sharing one with others. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: connectors and custom tools that expose data to Grok, sharing of conversations (not assistants) with licensed team members, and Grok Bot 'AI teammates', which is not described as a configurable, shareable assistant.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can build and share custom assistants with their own instructions and knowledge
